Temperatures of about 23-27°C (best 25°C) gave good feeding, vigour and growth, though the claims cite different optimal ranges (25-35°C in one paper), and several claims only describe how temperature was controlled.

basis.summary: Only paper S033 measured anything in mandarin fish (swimming, not water quality), so the water quality link rests on background claims about other species (S349) and a general statement; S370 is a different species and only descriptive, and the mixed claims were reported as such.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, water temperature change was measured to affect juvenile swimming, with 20°C values highest and 30°C lowest, and a stronger physiological change at higher temperatures was inferred; no claim directly measures a water quality outcome in this species. Background statements say warming raises ammonia excretion in another fish (pikeperch) and alters fish living conditions, and one claim on a different species (Pelteobagrus vachelli) only describes behaviour at low and high temperature.
statement_zh: 对鳜鱼来说，水温变化会明显影响幼鱼的游泳特征，20°C时数值最高、30°C时最低，并推断温度越高生理指标变化越大；但没有哪条结论在鳜鱼上直接测到水质方面的结果。背景性说法提到升温会使另一种鱼（大眼梭鲈）的氨排泄量增加、改变鱼类的生存条件，另有一条针对瓦氏黄颡鱼的结果只是描述了低温和高温下的行为。

basis.summary: The two measured claims from paper S370 carry the most weight because they report actual temperature-response results, while the death/feeding and gut-stress claims are only claimed or inferred and C4118 merely describes tank conditions; there is no real disagreement, as the 'counterevidence' claim also points to harm from unsuitable temperatures.

statement_en: Most claims say that keeping water temperature in a suitable, stable range supports feeding, growth and survival, while unsuitable or widely varying temperatures harm them. One measured study found best feeding and growth at 23–27°C (25°C optimal) in spotted mandarin fish fry, with growth falling at temperatures that were too high or too low; another claim links temperature swings to poorer feeding and death in juveniles, and another infers gut stress, while one claim only describes tank temperature without any welfare effect.
statement_zh: 多数结论认为，把水温保持在适宜且稳定的范围内有利于摄食、生长和成活，水温不适或温差过大则会带来不良影响。一项实测研究显示，斑鳜鱼苗在23至27℃摄食旺盛、生长快，25℃最适，过高或过低都会抑制早期发育；另有结论称温差过大会影响鳜夏花摄食并导致死亡，还有推断认为水温波动会引起肠道应激；另有一条只是描述了养殖缸的水温，没有说明对福利的影响。

basis.summary: All three claims are supportive and describe the same practice; only C13863 is marked as measured while the other two are claimed, so the summary is mostly descriptive of how the test is used, and there is no disagreement to resolve.

statement_en: Three papers describe water testing (putting a few fish into the treated water before stocking) as a way to confirm the water is safe. The observation periods stated are 24 hours (to check that the drug effect has gone) and 12 hours, and survival and activity are the signs watched; none of the claims report a harm or a lack of effect.
statement_zh: 三篇文献都把试水（正式投苗前先放少量鱼）当作确认水质安全的办法：用药处理后先放试水鱼观察，有的观察24小时以确认药性消失，有的观察12小时，看鱼的存活率和活力，再正式投放苗种。这些结论都没有报告不良影响或无效的情况。

basis.summary: Both claims are supportive and come from different papers, but they only address water temperature; C12139 was measured while C13930 was only claimed, so the latter carries less weight, and there was no disagreement to resolve.

statement_en: Two papers report that winter insulation kept water temperature steadier for mandarin fish: covering with film and adding well water held it at 19℃ in an open, uninsulated shed, and greenhouse cover with high water levels kept it above 10℃ with smaller temperature swings. Both are supportive, but they describe temperature control rather than other water quality measures, and only the first was measured.
statement_zh: 两篇文献都显示冬季保温有助于稳定鳜鱼养殖水温：在无保温设施的开放厂房里，覆盖薄膜并补充井水可把水温稳定在19℃；用大棚保温加高水位，可使水温保持在10℃以上并减小温差。两者结论都是正面的，但讲的都是水温控制，并不涉及其他水质指标，而且只有第一篇是实测的。
